desc.en: A legendary dragon that survived countless struggles, said to have surpassed the limits of life itself. While it seems to understand human language, it has no intention of conversing.
desc.ja: 数々の死闘を経て、生物の限界を超えたと言われている、伝説の竜。人間の言葉は理解できるようだが、対話するつもりはないらしい

note: Get Silver Dragon to transform into this on turn 4.
